planets.name: K2-83 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-83 with a 10-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-83 c was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around K2-83. Its orbit and size follow Crossfield et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
